message:
Interesting - the build is using the ASAN config by default (it's using `gcc` with ASAN flags). The build config must be set to use ASAN by default. The issue is that the ASAN runtime library is missing. Let me check what build config is being used and find the ASAN runtime:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cat /gt/_work/src/build_config.rb 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /gt/_work/src/build_config/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find / -name "libasan*" 2>/dev/null | head -10' 2>&1 | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
